core_result: Connects three topics around the torsion-free Hantzsche-Wendt (Promislow) group P and its standard 4x4 Bloch representation Psi (Passman, arXiv:2108.06570): R[P] -> M_4(R[x^+-1, y^+-1, z^+-1]) across 15 headline theorems (T1a-T3c) + 5 auxiliary/adversarial/master declarations in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 (6-kernel lake comparator --paranoid verified): (I) torsion-freeness of P, Klein V_4 conjugation of the Bloch matrix (the Lean determinant statement covers only the 8 integer sign points, where the V_4 action is the identity; constancy of unit determinants is argued on paper), exact 8-sign-point factorizations, Gardam's 21-term unit mod-4 congruence (89-term integer det with constant 97 and augmentation 945) (2-adic Hensel lifting: a generic identity in Lean, not instantiated for Gardam's unit; inverse supports computed in Rust/Python), failure of the 8 sign-point determinant test for all 2^21 sign lifts on Gardam's support (a necessary condition for a unit; the unit consequence is implied by Tabei arXiv:2608.00103) (and strengthened arbitrary even-sum p obstruction via quaternionic norm P_1^2 - 31 != +-1 at (1,1,-1)), and P-equivariant bijective 21-neighbor linear CA (ALG-035/ANL-063); (II) universal involutive-ring unit-twisted CSS commutation, complete 64-signed Haah conic discriminant classification (smooth for all p >= 5), an algebraic statement that no nontrivial monomial is constant on a rational parametrization of Haah's CC1 curve over integral domains with 2 != 0 containing roots of three quadratics of discriminant 5, plus one F_4 line (6 Bezout identities); the link to string operators is not formalized, a search showing p=23 is the first odd prime with an F_p-rational odd-order CC1 point (k_23(11)=6 is a Rust/Python computation, not Lean), and Gardam-twisted and intrinsic CSS stabilizer pairs over F_2[P]/Z[P] (no distance, logical-qubit or fracton property is formalized) with exact (52,52)/(52,56) weights and 342-term integer commutator defect (QC-032/CM-016); and (III) a non-strict origin-minimum lemma for midpoint-convex V_4-symmetric functions Q^3 -> Q (no Ronkin function in Lean), integer-point checks of defined amoeba inequality predicates and a nilpotent 2x2 matrix, and generation of S_4 by two permutations observed numerically as monodromies (CM-018/FLD-060). Paired with zero-dependency Rust core (4/4 tests, Ubuntu + Windows), Python exact oracle + Hypothesis + differential tests (9/9), 6/6 (100%) killed mutants, 18/18 live Crossref/arXiv citations (0 retractions), 10-page zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room arXiv tarball, live 3D WebGL2 Studio & Proof Blueprint on GitHub Pages, SLSA Attestation #72484621 (Rekor 4117699930), Software Heritage full snapshot swh:1:snp:3de955e528951f543794d11b7c4ec43d5869e611, and 90/90 Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
verification_boundary: All 20 audited declarations across Pillars I-III, NonVacuity, Adversarial, and Palomar comparator contracts are kernel-checked in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] by the Lean kernel; the 16 comparator targets and their dependency closure were also accepted by 6 kernel checks (5 distinct implementations) on Ubuntu CI (run 45751946493). Numerical 3D Ronkin quadrature (O(1/N) nodal-singularity convergence), bipolar skin-effect winding grids (max_err = 0.0), and continuous-loop canonical quartic discriminant braid degrees (-1,-3,-2,+3) are verified differentially between zero-dependency Rust and Python rather than in Lean real analysis. The unit conjecture is false over C (Gardam, arXiv:2312.05240, for this group P). Whether Z[P] or Q[P] has non-trivial units for unrestricted supports, Gottschalk's Surjunctivity Conjecture for non-sofic groups, and distance scaling of HW covers remain OPEN; claims no external peer review or external DOI.
